newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Saehan Merchant closes US$50 mln FRCD.
newsitem.headline: Saehan Merchant closes US$50 mln FRCD.

text.p: Saehan Merchant Bank's US$50 million floating rate certificate of deposit issue has been allotted, arranger IBJ Asia said.
The three-year facility has no put or call options. The issue was priced at par to float at 50 basis points over the three-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is 62 basis points.
Arranger and lead manager IBJ Asia committed US$9 million. Other arrangers and lead managers, with US$8 million each, are KDB Asia, LTCB Asia and WestLB Asia Pacific.
Co-lead managers, with US$5 million each, are Australia New Zealand Banking Group Seoul Branch, Bank Austria Aktiengesellschaft Hong Kong, and Creditanstalt-Bankverein, Hong Kong.
Co-manager Banca di Roma committed US$2 million.
